summary: The lattice-fiber count and both primitive-slice bounds are correct. For every shear, integer center, and unimodular basis, the eroded pair body projects into a base erosion of planar measure zero: centers outside or on the boundary of P give an empty erosion, while the sole interior center is handled by a valid unimodular-width obstruction. The resulting three-dimensional volume is therefore zero for every parameter triple, so the supremum is zero. The final halfspace-depth calculation is also correct.
